<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Ball completely static regardless of paddle pos / SPACE / waiting. Try moving paddle UP toward ball row.
# Paddle at rows 16-19, cols 28-47 (approx, after LEFT/RIGHT). Move UP x3 to rows 4-7 (ball row).
def snap():
    out={}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','c','M','N'):
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out[n['color']]=(min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return out
print('before', snap())
r = action(['UP']*3)
print('after UPx3', snap(), r['state'])
# check if paddle overlaps ball region
b = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='b'][0]
print('paddle pixels', b['pixels'], 'boundary', b['boundary'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
